Chapter 1201 - 18: Explosion! (Subscription Requested)

Chapter 1201: Chapter 18: Explosion! (Subscription Requested)

Since the twelve Peak Venerables of the Da Fu Ancient Country have arrived, the competition for the treasure land officially begins.

Almost simultaneously.

The Peak Venerables of the six ancient countries all entered the treasure land together.

"Time reversal?"

Lin Yuan sensed a trace of the power of time flowing around.

Those lacking in time-space comprehension will be unable to avoid the influence of this power, slipping back to a position a few breaths earlier.

When this first-class treasure land was first discovered, it was by a Great Lord exploring nearby. However, these Great Lords could barely even enter, let alone obtain the rare treasures produced within.

Quickly.

Lin Yuan crossed the time flow area and stepped into the treasure land.

"Such vast space-time?"

Lin Yuan glanced around, pondering silently.

Initially, a first-class treasure land remains connected to the source world upon its emergence, but this connection gradually fades with time, manifesting as the treasure land’s space-time continuously dwindles.

For example, the Hei Yu Nest, this first-class treasure land emerged countless ages ago, and its space-time has shrunk significantly, so much so that it takes only two breaths for Jihan Venerate and Beiyin Venerable Sage to infiltrate the treasure land and reach its core.

It is akin to an unripe fruit connected to the mother tree, essentially a part of it.

But once the fruit matures and detaches from the mother tree, it becomes merely a fruit.

The principle is similar for treasure lands.

"Red Lotus, Galaxy, you two search in that direction."

Red Flame Venerable immediately commanded, arranging for ten Peak Venerables to disperse and search, and to notify him and Venerable Guanglie immediately upon discovering the treasure land’s ’core’.

Then Red Flame Venerable and Venerable Guanglie would personally proceed to refine it.

"Alright."

Lin Yuan saw no issue with this arrangement and immediately proceeded in the direction he needed to explore.

Since the treasure land’s ’core’ might exist anywhere, the search could only be conducted by flying slowly, as void traversal would be too prone to oversight.

As for deploying domain methods to investigate? When the treasure land just emerged, while connected to the source world, even Lin Yuan’s Divine Ability ’World’ could only lock onto a surrounding area of a hundred billion li. Anything farther could lead to omissions.

Swish!

Lin Yuan’s figure vanished, heading in the direction arranged by Red Flame Venerable.

"This first-class treasure land is indeed extraordinary, it feels even heavier than the Hei Yu Nest?" Lin Yuan thought silently, comparing as he personally entered this first-class treasure land.

At the capital of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

Within an independent space.

The twelve Peak Venerables involved in the treasure land competition, including Red Flame Venerable and Venerable Hengyang, all left an avatar here for communication at any time.

"I discovered a core of the treasure land!"

At this moment, Red Lotus Venerable suddenly opened his eyes and said.

"So soon?"

Lin Yuan looked at Red Lotus Venerable. Discovering a ’core’ shortly after entering the treasure land could only be attributed to exceptional luck.

"I’ll head over right away."

Red Flame Venerable immediately said.

At the same time, within the first-class treasure land, Red Flame Venerable, who had been overseeing the entire situation without moving, immediately headed to Red Lotus Venerable’s location.

"Where is the treasure land’s ’core’..."

Lin Yuan investigated carefully, "Oh? Is that a Peak Venerable from Xuanyin Ancient Country?"

Suddenly, Lin Yuan’s expression shifted slightly. Far to the left front, a Peak Venerable from Xuanyin Ancient Country seemed to be on a trajectory that intersected with Lin Yuan’s path.

The Peak Venerable from Xuanyin Ancient Country glanced at Lin Yuan from afar, but did not linger, continuing along his exploratory path.

Fierce Sun Ancient Country and Xuanyin Ancient Country are continually at war, but entering the treasure land this time is primarily for refining the ’core’.

Without a ’core’, the two Peak Venerables wouldn’t even clash, as that would merely please the other ancient country Venerables.

"With my outer-world coverage compared to other Peak Venerables, I surely have an advantage," Lin Yuan thought, as he himself was suppressed to only investigate within a hundred billion li radius.

Other Venerables would be even more harshly suppressed.

"But I shouldn’t underestimate them, all are Peak Venerables, and some are even top-notch Peak Venerables. There’s no knowing what methods they might have."

Lin Yuan remained cautious.

...

Another part of the treasure land.

The twelve Peak Venerables of the Da Ling Ancient Country descended simultaneously.

"Leave a main battle body with me."

Spirit Prison Venerable glanced at the other eleven Peak Venerables, "I have a Secret Technique that can slightly sense the treasure land’s ’core’ aura. Upon detecting it, I’ll head there directly, and release your main battle bodies to refine the treasure land ’core’, then proceed to the next ’core’."

"Alright."

The eleven Peak Venerables of Da Ling Ancient Country nodded, having already devised a plan for refining the treasure land ’core’ prior, with everything centered around Spirit Prison Venerable.

Spirit Prison Venerable’s Chaos Spirit Prison technique was not only effective at trapping other Peak Venerables but also remotely sensing the treasure land’s ’core’.

Though this sensing has many limitations, it’s far superior to slowly flying and searching.

After each handing over their main battle body to Spirit Prison Venerable, the eleven Venerables of Da Ling Ancient Country also searched in different directions.

Even though this treasure land contest is primarily led by Spirit Prison Venerable, they must make multiple plans, not relying solely on Spirit Prison Venerable.

"Hmm?"

Spirit Prison Venerable’s expression suddenly changed, gazing into a certain direction, stepping forward, and vanishing on the spot.

...

"Hahahaha, I discovered a treasure land core so quickly."

A Peak Venerable from Thunderclap Ancient Country gazed excitedly at the illusory heavenly pillar before him.

The illusory heavenly pillar merged into the treasure land core, only detectable when close enough.

"I’ll start attempting to refine it now." This Peak Venerable from Thunderclap Ancient Country, after informing the other eleven Peak Venerables of the core’s location, immediately began the refining attempt.

At that moment.

Space-time subtly twisted.

The figure of Spirit Prison Venerable appeared, overlooking the Thunderclap Ancient Country’s Peak Venerable attempting to refine below.

"Spirit Prison?"

This Peak Venerable from Thunderclap Ancient Country, immediately noticing Spirit Prison Venerable, growled softly, "This treasure land core belongs to my Thunderclap Ancient Country."

"Is that so?"

Spirit Prison Venerable looked down, a sneer on his face: "Just now it was yours, now it’s mine."

As soon as the words fell.

The left eye of the Spirit Prison Venerate rapidly began to expand, forming a prison that reached the heavens and the earth, enveloping the Peak Venerable of the Thunderclap Ancient Country within.

"What is this?"

The Peak Venerable of the Thunderclap Ancient Country struggled with all his might, but to no avail, and was quickly absorbed into the left eye of the Spirit Prison Venerate.

"Trapping you for a month is more than enough."

Feeling the struggle within his left eye prison, the Spirit Prison Venerate casually remarked.

Trapped for a month? It must be noted that the entire time to contend for the treasured grounds totals only two thousand years.

The most critical phase is likely the first few decades.

"Come out."

The Spirit Prison Venerate immediately released the main battle physical bodies of several Peak Venerables from the Da Ling Ancient Country, "You begin refining now."

"Yes."

These Peak Venerables felt invigorated; they too sensed that the Peak Venerable of the Thunderclap Ancient Country posed no resistance in front of the Spirit Prison Venerate and was directly suppressed by the left eye prison.

...

Very soon.

The core of this treasured ground was refined by several Peak Venerables from the Da Ling Ancient Country.

"Hmm?"

The Spirit Prison Venerate, constantly operating the perception secret technique, made another discovery, and his figure disappeared from where he stood.

...

Elsewhere.

Lin Yuan, who was rapidly exploring, showed a slight change in expression.

"What is this?"

The next moment, Lin Yuan appeared billions of miles away, facing an illusory sky pillar standing tall, almost fused with the surrounding space and time.

"Treasure ground ’core’."

Lin Yuan’s face broke into a smile.

Since Red Lotus Venerable discovered the first treasure ground core, subsequently, five other Heavenly Venerates have discovered treasure ground cores.

The treasure ground core before Lin Yuan should be the seventh core discovered by the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

.....

Upon discovering this treasure ground ’core’, Lin Yuan immediately contacted Red Flame Venerable and Venerable Guanglie.

"I will refine it myself first."

Red Flame Venerable and Venerable Guanglie were on their way and needed time; Lin Yuan could definitely refine part of it during this period.

This would save the time needed for complete refinement.

Rustling.

With this thought, Lin Yuan immediately set to work.

"Hmm?"

Just then, Lin Yuan’s expression changed, and he looked up.

A figure silently appeared there, looking down at Lin Yuan.

"Galaxy Venerate of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country?"

The Spirit Prison Venerate’s face revealed a smile. With the power of the chaos spirit prison he developed, as long as he didn’t meet Fu Xu Venerate of the Da Fu Ancient Country, other Peak Venerables, even top Peak Venerables, could be trapped for a time.

And Galaxy Venerate?

Even though he was the first in the six grand ancient countries to transform ancestral bloodlines into a Heavenly Venerate level entity, he was far from being able to contend with him.

"Spirit Prison Venerate?"

Lin Yuan’s expression was grave. The strength of the Spirit Prison Venerate was definitely on par with Red Flame Venerable and Venerable Guanglie, and in terms of being difficult to deal with, he even surpassed the former.

An independent space of Fierce Sun Country.

"Spirit Prison Venerate has gone there?" Red Flame Venerable looked at Lin Yuan, eyebrows tightly knit, "Immediately withdraw from that treasure ground core."

"Withdraw from the treasure ground core?" Lin Yuan looked at Red Flame Venerable. After going to great lengths to find a treasure ground core, just let it be handed over to the Spirit Prison Venerate like that?

"If you do not withdraw, and you get trapped within the prison of the Spirit Prison Venerate, the losses to our Fierce Sun Ancient Country would only be greater," Red Flame Venerable calmly said.

Even though letting go of the treasure ground core made him very unwilling, if they stalled further, the loss faced by the Fierce Sun Ancient Country would be more than just this treasure core, even Lin Yuan might be involved.

...

"Red Flame Venerable told me to retreat."

Lin Yuan looked at the Spirit Prison Venerate above, secretly thinking to himself.

"Enter my spirit prison."

The Spirit Prison Venerate looked down at Lin Yuan, his right eye began to spread and expand, transforming into a towering and thorough spirit prison, instantly enveloping Lin Yuan, then absorbing him into the right eye.

Suppressing and trapping the Heavenly Venerates from other ancient countries would only cause greater losses to those countries, so the Spirit Prison Venerate naturally wouldn’t pass up the chance.

"You refine quickly."

After absorbing Galaxy Venerate into the right eye spirit prison, the Spirit Prison Venerate waved his hand, and several Venerates from the Da Ling Ancient Country appeared.

"Yes."

These Venerates from the Da Ling Ancient Country looked at the Spirit Prison Venerate, their spirits unprecedentedly invigorated.

In such a short time, they had snatched two treasure ground cores from other ancient countries, and if this continues, the number of cores refined by the Da Ling Ancient Country would certainly not be small.

However.

Just as these Peak Venerables from the Da Ling Ancient Country were about to descend and refine the illusory sky pillar.

They suddenly noticed the previously calm and indifferent Spirit Prison Venerate’s expression drastically change, unable to control his retreating body, while his right hand instinctively covered his right eye.

"Spirit Prison, what’s wrong?"

The Peak Venerables from the Da Ling Ancient Country sensed something was wrong and immediately inquired.

"I....."

The remaining left eye of the Spirit Prison Venerate showed incredulity as he looked at the Peak Venerables from the Da Ling Ancient Country, "Stay away from me."

"Stay away?"

The Peak Venerables from the Da Ling Ancient Country glanced at each other, unsure of what had happened.

However, what they didn’t know was that on the surface of the Spirit Prison Venerate’s right eye, tightly covered, red light began to appear.

If the red light were magnified billions of times, it would be like a series of fiery suns.

The red light spots, infinite and endless, instantly filled the surface of the Spirit Prison Venerate’s eyeball.

At this moment, the Spirit Prison Venerate’s right eye, under the endless red light, seemed to have transformed into a fireball.

The next moment.

The Spirit Prison Venerate’s right eye exploded directly.
